# AstryxCodeBlock { #anylumino.AstryxCodeBlock }

```python
AstryxCodeBlock(code, *, language='python', **props)
```

Render syntax-highlighted code with Astryx styling.

## Parameters {.doc-section .doc-section-parameters}

| Name     | Type   | Description                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | Default    |
|----------|--------|-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------|------------|
| code     | str    | Astryx component option.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | _required_ |
| language | str    | Code language used for syntax highlighting.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   | `'python'` |
| **props  | Any    | JSON-safe CodeBlock props. Useful keys: title, hasLanguageLabel, hasLineNumbers, highlightLines, hasCopyButton, isWrapped, maxHeight, size, width, container, isCollapsible, collapsibleThreshold, data-testid, className, and style. Upstream tokenizer expects a JavaScript function and is not usable from Python props. anylumino manages code and language. See Astryx component docs: <https://astryx.atmeta.com/components/CodeBlock>. | `{}`       |
